description:
Activate Towering Titan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Towering Titan enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Towering Titan enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Towering Titan.
Activate Towering Titan using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
